correctness.rationale: The infinite family has an explicit valid orientation forcing all m cycle vertices, and in every valid orientation the pendant leaf has no out-arc, yielding the matching upper bound. Deleting c3 leaves a unicyclic graph on m vertices with exactly two leaves, whose only valid orientations yield gamma_t=m-2. Connected noncycles have DOM_t at most order minus one; any valid oriented graph has directed total-domination number at least three, proving minimum six-vertex order. The provided C++ program enumerates all 2^15 six-vertex graphs, all relevant orientations and selected subsets, and all 720 relabelings; it verifies 9000 labeled pairs, 5850 underlying graphs and 18 marked classes. Two independently structured scripts check the family and the 18-class census.
